faq.name: pricing-faq
faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Pricing FAQ — Plans, Credits & Billing
faq.description: Common questions about choosing a plan, credits, Plus, and refunds.

items.title: Which plan should I pick?
items.description: If you have one focused decision (e.g., "should I move to Lisbon or Barcelona?"), Standard at $9.9 is enough. If you're comparing 3-5 cities or want permanent chat history, choose Professional at $19.9. If you're planning an entire relocation year with multiple candidate cities, Research Pass at $29.9 unlocks 90-day timing and up to 5 saved projects. If you want to keep tracking cities as your plans change, Plus Monthly at $7.9 is the most flexible option.

items.title: How much can I do with 150, 500, or 1000 credits?
items.description: Roughly: 1 AI chat = 10 credits, 1 full city comparison report = 50 credits. So 150 credits ≈ 15 chats or 3 city comparisons. 500 credits ≈ 50 chats or 10 comparisons. 1000 credits ≈ 100 chats or 20 comparisons. A typical first round of research (1 full city comparison + 10 follow-ups) costs about 150 credits.

items.title: Do credits expire?
items.description: No — all credits from Standard, Professional, and Research Pass are valid forever. You can take your time, save your research, and come back months later. Plus subscription credits refresh every month while you're subscribed, and any unused monthly credits do not roll over.

items.title: What's the difference between Standard and Professional?
items.description: Standard ($9.9, 150 credits) is for a single focused decision. Professional ($19.9, 500 credits) adds 3.3× more credits plus two exclusive features: (1) ⭐ permanent chat history — revisit and re-export past sessions from your account, and (2) ⭐ advanced planetary line analysis including Chiron, Lilith, and midpoint work. If you only need the AI chat once, Standard is enough. If you'll come back to your research or want deeper chart work, Professional pays off quickly.

items.title: Plus Monthly vs Plus Yearly — which should I pick?
items.description: Plus Monthly ($7.9/mo) is best if you want to try Plus through one real move or trip with no long-term commitment. Plus Yearly ($71/yr, about $5.92/mo) saves you ~34% and is best if you know you'll be researching for the full year. Both give 150 credits/month, full 30-day timing, and 90-day timing while active. Cancel anytime.

items.title: What happens to my research projects if I cancel Plus?
items.description: Your saved projects and shortlist are kept in your account. However, after cancellation: 90-day timing windows become read-only, monthly credit refresh stops, and you fall back to the entitlements of your last one-time purchase (if any). Standard users keep their credits and 30-day timing preview. To get 90-day timing permanently, buy the Research Pass instead of subscribing.

items.title: What does the Research Pass include that Professional doesn't?
items.description: Research Pass adds 4 exclusive features on top of everything in Professional: (1) ⭐ permanent 90-day timing access (not just while subscribed), (2) ⭐ save up to 5 research projects side by side, (3) ⭐ batch export multiple chat sessions as TXT files at once, and (4) ⭐ priority email support with 24-hour response time. Plus you get 1000 credits (2× Professional) for serious research volume.

items.title: What is your refund policy?
items.description: Standard and Professional one-time purchases qualify for a full change-of-mind refund within 7 days of payment with fewer than 3 completed paid AI uses (0–2). Each question-and-answer or paid report counts once, not each chat window. Research Pass: 7 days with fewer than 5 uses. First Plus payments, monthly or yearly when offered, have a 7-day guarantee with fewer than 5 uses. Billing errors, non-delivery and service problems are reviewed separately; mandatory rights are unaffected.

items.title: Can I pay with Alipay, WeChat Pay, or other local methods?
items.description: Yes. We support Stripe (international credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay) and Creem (Alipay, WeChat Pay for Chinese users). The payment method selector appears automatically when you check out — pick whichever works for your region. Prices may be slightly adjusted for CNY payments to account for currency conversion.
